title: Late-life semaglutide treatment slows ageing and extends lifespan in female mice.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Fetched the GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) series record for GSE338091: bulk liver RNA-seq, 10 samples (GSM9866416-GSM9866425), one GSE338091_RAW.tar supplement, public since Jul 2026. Did not download the tar. Grepped the open-access full text for cohort sizes. Europe PMC supplementary-file listing timed out (135 s), so the per-figure Source Data spreadsheets were not opened.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Lifespan cohort of 39 saline + 40 semaglutide mice; longitudinal cohort of 10 mice per group x 3 groups (vehicle, semaglutide, 24% calorie restriction) measured at baseline, 2 and 4 months; RNA-seq n = 5 mice per group; median lifespan 742 vs 834 days; per-figure Source Data files exist.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO record is public and has a RAW.tar (checked the record, not the tar). Source Data files are on the publisher site; Europe PMC supplement listing timed out.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Treatment group and lifespan in days would be columns in Source Data per the paper; not opened.

a3_inputs_present.note: Per-mouse physiological measures and liver expression are present per paper/GEO record.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked in files; physiological assays in standard units per paper.

a5_enough_rows.note: Largest cohort is 79 mice (lifespan study, from paper text); longitudinal study 30 mice; RNA-seq 10 samples (verified in GEO). Far below ~400 even for classification.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: GEO shows 10 samples, matching n = 5 per group stated in the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Lifespan and treatment are direct experimental records, not model output.

existing_models.name: FRIGHT and AFRAID (frailty-based age and life-expectancy clocks, Schultz et al., Nature Communications 2020)
existing_models.score_and_split: Random-forest clocks on longitudinal frailty data from naturally ageing C57BL/6 mice; reported responsive to enalapril and methionine restriction. Split details not retrieved.

backbone.name: none suitable (bulk mouse liver RNA-seq, 10 samples)

honest_claim_h3: With 79 mice in two arms, a model could at best describe which early physiological measures track survival in this one cohort of aged female C57BL/6 mice; no generalizable claim is supportable.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use early physical-function measurements of old mice to predict how long each mouse will live under drug or diet treatment.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-mouse physiological and behavioural measurements after treatment start; at most 79 mice (lifespan cohort, from paper text).
plain_idea.predict: Each mouse's lifespan in days, recorded at death in the lifespan study.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: An early predictor of lifespan would shorten mouse ageing-intervention trials, but this cohort is far too small to train or test one.

ml_idea: Predict individual lifespan or treatment group from early physiological measures or liver transcriptome; infeasible at n = 79 mice / 10 RNA-seq samples.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected at A5 on sample size.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count mice per cohort: 79 lifespan, 30 longitudinal, 10 RNA-seq (killed it).

verdict_reason: Fails A5: a classic small-cohort mouse intervention study with 79 mice in the lifespan arm, 30 in the longitudinal arm and 10 liver RNA-seq samples (GEO-verified); too few units for any ML model.
